LESSON: SIGN READING 15.2.1 SIGN READING FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.2: Sign Reading 15.2.1 Sign Reading Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 15.2.1 Sign Reading Fluency, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to read and sign fluently? 2. How can you improve your reading fluency?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise the signs of vocabulary related to the theme for effective communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sign Reading 15.2.1 Sign Reading Fluency in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. recognise the use of fluency strategies in the sign reading and reading process,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sign Reading 15.2.1 Sign Reading Fluency in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. apply fluency strategies while sign reading,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sign Reading 15.2.1 Sign Reading Fluency in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 15.2.1 Sign Reading Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learner develops the skill of self awareness as they gain confidence in reading by applying fluency strategies.

● Citizenship: Learner develops the skill of global awareness as they read about tourist attraction sites in Kenya.

Values:
● Unity: is achieved as learners display team spirit as they work in pairs to watch or listen to sample captioned audio-visual reading clips

and simulate models.

Link to other Subjects

● The learner relates the skill of sign reading fluency to their learning all other subjects such as Creative Arts
